mod.name: TB Jewels of Survival
mod.summary: A mining and crafting chain. Players mine ores at spawn areas, smelt metals, grind diamonds into gems, and forge magic rings on an anvil. Seven ring types (Attack, Defense, Dragon Blood, Eagle Eye, Life, Owl, Perseverance) give bonuses in three levels, and higher levels are made by combining two rings of the previous level.
mod.notes: The ring pages on the doc site only show pictures, so what each ring does is not described there; the field help therefore avoids claiming exact ring effect values. Installation needs two server starts: once to generate the files, once after editing them. The doc page for GrinderRecipeConfiguration describes a file named GrinderRecipeConfig.json on disk.

files.title: Anvil (ring crafting)
files.summary: Recipes for forging the rings on the anvil: ingots and gems for level 1, and two rings of the previous level plus a gem for levels 2 and 3.

files.title: Smelter
files.summary: Speed, fuel use and portability of the smelter that turns ore into ingots.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Version number the mod writes into this file so it can upgrade older files. Leave it exactly as it is.
version.risk: Changing it can make the mod reset or reject the file.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Leave it alone.

takeGasPerTick.label: Gas per tick
takeGasPerTick.help: How much gas the smelter burns each cycle.

tickCountToProduceCopper.label: Cycles to smelt copper
tickCountToProduceCopper.help: Number of cycles needed to produce copper. Multiply by the tick length for the real time.

tickCountToProduceIron.label: Cycles to smelt iron
tickCountToProduceIron.help: Number of cycles needed to produce iron. Multiply by the tick length for the real time.

tickCountToProduceSilver.label: Cycles to smelt silver
tickCountToProduceSilver.help: Number of cycles needed to produce silver. Multiply by the tick length for the real time.

tickCountToProduceGold.label: Cycles to smelt gold
tickCountToProduceGold.help: Number of cycles needed to produce gold. Multiply by the tick length for the real time.

staticSmelterNeedsGas.label: Fixed smelter needs gas
staticSmelterNeedsGas.help: 1 means the fixed smelter needs a gas canister, 0 means it burns nothing.

configMode.label: Portable use
configMode.help: 1 allows the device to be picked up and carried in the hands and inventory; 0 keeps it as a fixed object.
